summary: Build a practical go-to-market strategy with ICPs, pricing, channels, and KPI dashboards. Train your team to launch with clarity and control.
lede: Go-to-market strategy is a structured plan for choosing a target market, defining an offer, selecting channels and coordinating a launch. It is for professionals across product, marketing, sales, growth and revenue operations who need to plan launches and track commercial results. The course covers market analysis and ideal customer profiles, positioning and pricing, channel sequencing, launch roadmaps, and pipeline and revenue measurement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape launch decisions, coordinate go-to-market execution, or report commercial progress to leadership. It is a strong fit if you work across product, marketing, sales, revenue operations, or partnerships and need a practical framework for launch planning.
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a current or recent launch challenge if available. Familiarity with basic marketing metrics, CRM data, or product planning documents will help you work faster during the exercises.
